==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Yangming:''' Shh, keep it down. Mom won't hear me if it's too loud.
:{{DIcon}} Your mom?
:'''Yangming:''' Right! Mom is a very impressive [[Midnight Rangers|Midnight Ranger]]. She's taken down tons of [[Tacet Discord]]s!
:'''Yangming:''' I come here every night to talk to her.
:{{DIcon}} You come to talk here?
:'''Yangming:''' [[Hualin|Grandpa]] says this is the only place where Mom can hear me.
:'''Yangming:''' So, every night, I come here and tell her what happened during the day.
----
;(Subsequent interaction - Set 1)
:'''Yangming:''' Mom, I've been a good boy today. Didn't make the teacher angry.
:'''Yangming:''' The teacher said as long as I work a little harder, I'll get a good grade for the next exam.

;(Subsequent interaction - Set 2)
:'''Yangming:''' Mom, guess what? Grandpa got mixed up again while cooking dinner today.
:'''Yangming:''' He used [[sugar]] instead of [[salt]]! We were eating and it was so sweet we couldn't stop laughing!
:'''Yangming:''' The dishes you cooked were better... Sob... Sob...
:'''Yangming:''' No, I'm fine. I'm a grown man now. I shouldn't cry.

;(Subsequent interaction - Set 3)
:'''Yangming:''' I'm so sleepy. I should head back. We talked a lot today.
:'''Yangming:''' Mom, let's chat again tomorrow night. I'll have more stories to share.
:'''Yangming:''' Goodbye... Mom.
{{Dialogue End}}
